name: 对比度增强检测
description: 检测 直方图 篡改 伪影 from 对比度 adjustments like levels, curves, or gamma correction.
algorithm: Peak-Gap Artifact Detection in Pixel Value Histograms
mechanism: Contrast enhancement operations create characteristic peak-gap 模式 in the pixel intensity 直方图. This method 检测 these 伪影 通过分析 the regularity and spacing of peaks and valleys.
parameters: Histogram bins: 256, Gap 阈值: 自适应, Peak 检测: local maxima, Smoothing: Gaussian σ=1
source: Stamm, M.C. & Liu, K.J.R. (2008) — Forensic Detection of Image Manipulation Using Statistical Intrinsic Fingerprints, IEEE ICME
useCase: Detecting 亮度/对比度 adjustments used to unify appearance in composited images

references.title: Stamm, M.C. & Liu, K.J.R. (2008) — Forensic Detection of Image Manipulation Using Statistical Intrinsic Fingerprints, IEEE ICME

strengths:
• 检测 multiple enhancement types
• Works on both global and local adjustments
• Fast 直方图-based 分析
• Well-established 取证 technique
limitations:
• Cannot detect very subtle adjustments
• Multiple enhancements may cancel 伪影
• JPEG压缩 affects 直方图
• Limited to intensity-based 篡改s
